_help: Act 7, after the artifacts are recovered (either way): Tariq Selim, the Keepers' messenger, and the new objective (new_objective = return_artifacts). Fletcher's plane is mentioned if he helped (Act 8's air route). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py.

start.speaker: tariq
start.line: The Sheikh sent me. He says: you have them. Good. Now hear the rest. The guardian does not stop because the amulet changed hands. He follows it. Wherever you take it, he comes.

objective.speaker: tariq
objective.line: Only in its cradle does he sleep. You must carry it back to Akmentar, all of it, before the veil tears.

r_eleanor.speaker: eleanor
r_eleanor.line: Back to Akmentar. Of course. I think I knew that from the moment I read the cradle.

r_hassan.speaker: hassan
r_hassan.line: Back to the door I tried to keep you from. God has a sense of humour.

r_hargreaves.speaker: hargreaves
r_hargreaves.line: Right. Water, ammunition, and anyone who can still hold a rifle. We leave tonight.

r_isabelle.speaker: isabelle
r_isabelle.line: So we run toward the thing everyone else is running from. Typical.

fletcher.speaker: fletcher
fletcher.line: And if you need a lift, old man, I've got a crate that flies and nothing better to do with it.
